cost: For E events, Q query classes, L lemma-comparison work and H snapshot/history work: ranking O(E*(Q*L+H)+E log E), potentially twice on fallback. Dispatch includes branch-dependent histories; no complete bound. LCS n*m cell updates and m+1 usize cells.
description: Scoped answer composition: lexical/question interpretation -> subject/anchor resolution -> intent dispatch -> State(text,note,anchor) or None(empty text,note,anchor). Ranking weights each query class exclusively: verb 3, participant 1.5, text 1, then role/section bonuses. Selected why paths prioritize explicit why, causal how, cause event, agent belief, goal, fulfilled intent; feeling-specific search precedes ordinary events. Other branches are read but not comprehensively modeled. Wave34 adds five scoped nested children and exact safe helper evidence; historical evidence retains its original epoch.
